plugins.name: clipugc
plugins.description: ClipUGC skills for Claude Code — ugc-director (turn an app idea into a TikTok-style ad plan: reaction archetypes, hooks, casting, prompts) + the clipugc CLI: create AI characters, generate looks, produce video clips, merge app recordings into UGC ads, and manage credits from natural language. New: story-runner — ongoing story series where an AI character lives a continuing life in short talking episodes, each picking up from the previous episode’s last frame.
